record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare NATURAL_GIFT in this production reference (CHERUBI has passive NONE; CHERRIM and CHERRIM_SUNLIGHT have passive BLOSSOM). The strategy is shared; differences are the star count.
record.summary: Heals the team entity with the lowest hp/maxHP ratio (the caster included) and gives it rune protect. The heal is a requested 30/60/90 (raw, by stars 1/2/3; 150 for 4 or more) with AP scaling (apBoost 1) and the cast's crit flag; rune protect lasts 1000/2000/3000 ms (6000 for 4+) and its trigger clears the target's listed negative statuses. If the target is wounded the HP heal is 0 (the Blood Moon / Blood Stone shield branch may still add a shield) but the rune protect is still applied. The default cast animation is suppressed and a custom one aimed at the chosen ally is broadcast.

targeting.who: the board entity of the caster's team with the lowest hp/maxHP; ties keep the first in board.cells order (row-major index columns x y) because the sort is stable; no target is passed to the strategy (target null)
targeting.note: requiresTarget is false, so the cast fires from the moving state without an enemy in range. board.cells is filtered with cell && cell.team === pokemon.team: the caster itself and every living team entity count; whether dead entities are removed from cells before this runs was not traced. If no entity matches (the caster is always on the board while casting) nothing is healed.

geometry.shape: single ally anywhere on the board (no range or positional limit)

effects.scaling: requested amount: raw x (1 + 1 x caster.AP / 100), then x caster.critPower only if the cast crit flag is true (needs ABILITY_CRIT: canCritByDefault is false)
effects.resolution: applied change comes from PokemonState.handleHeal on the chosen ally: wounded target -> healReceived 0 (shield branch with Blood Moon + Blood Stone: round(0.3 x stones x requested heal) through addShield); nothing for a target at 0 hp or protected; otherwise x1.3 BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED, x0.5 burn, x0.5 enraged, x1.2 ZENITH, rounded, capped at the target's missing HP. A full-HP lowest-ratio ally therefore receives 0 HP (the cast still sets rune protect).

effects.scaling: none from AP or crit (the duration is a fixed table value)
effects.resolution: Status.triggerRuneProtect sets runeProtect = true, clears the listed negative statuses on the ally (clearNegativeStatus: burn, silence, fatigue, poison, freeze, sleep, confusion, wound, paralysis, charm, flinch, armor reduction, curse flag, possession unless from the same team, locked, blind) and raises runeProtectCooldown to the duration only if it is longer than the remaining one. It does not pass through applyStatusDurationReductions. A wounded ally is cleared of wound (woundCooldown 0) by the clear, but this happens after the heal request, so the heal still saw the wound.

statusEffects.applicationOrder: after the heal request, inside the same if (lowestHealthAlly) block, before the animation broadcast
statusEffects.guards: no guard in the strategy; the cooldown is only raised when the new duration is longer than the remaining time
statusEffects.combatEffect: rune protect makes later status triggers (for example triggerFlinch, which checks runeProtect first) a no-op while active; its full list of effects was not enumerated here (runeProtect appears in 26 places in status.ts and in a few ability files, which were not audited).

starBehavior.note: both tables are indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star value (150 / 6000, also the fallback) is not reachable by the three units' star counts (1, 2, 3). maxPP is 65 and range 3 for all three. CHERRIM and CHERRIM_SUNLIGHT carry passive BLOSSOM, which only transforms between the two forms with the spotlight and does not change the cast.

record.positionalConditions: None. The target is chosen by hp ratio over the whole team; no range or line is involved.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. Each cast re-evaluates the lowest ratio; a second rune protect only extends the timer if its duration is longer than the remaining time.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: heal 30/60/90 (1/2/3 stars) and rune protect 1000/2000/3000 ms. Requested heal = raw x (1 + AP/100) [x critPower on a crit]; the applied HP change is that value after wound, protect, the heal modifiers and the cap at missing HP (0 on a full-HP or wounded target). The rune protect duration is not scaled and is applied regardless of the heal result.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence); the moving-state and attacking-state gates were read
Crit resolution: only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate in castAbility was read
Everything runeProtect blocks in combat beyond the cited status triggers

Consulted for the heal helpers: PokemonState.handleHeal at the pinned commit (wound, protect, modifier chain, cap at missing HP); the shared references core-mechanics.md section B/H were not needed for a heal
unresolved: Whether dead entities can still sit in board.cells when the filter runs (they would be eligible with hp 0 / maxHP ratio 0 and then receive no heal); not traced
Whether applyStatusDurationReductions or other effects shorten the rune protect duration: triggerRuneProtect does not call it, but other code reading runeProtectCooldown was not enumerated
The remaining effects of runeProtect elsewhere in combat (only the flinch trigger guard and clearNegativeStatus were read)
Whether any item or synergy effect changes NATURAL_GIFT beyond what is listed
Which units hold the CHERRIM / CHERRIM_SUNLIGHT forms at runtime depends on the spotlight; only the declared catalog stars are modelled
